title: Berman-Hartmanis Isomorphism Conjecture
exact_target: Are all NP-complete languages the same up to a reversible, polynomial-time change of their binary encodings?

sources.citation: Allender, Cai, Fortnow, Gasarch, Immerman, Kurtz, Royer, and Williams, Open Problems by or Inspired by Juris Hartmanis, ACM SIGACT News 53(4), 2022, section 5.3, printed p. 7.
